snippet.title: REPLACED - Release Date Trailer - April 14, 2026
snippet.description:
Uncover the sinister secrets of Phoenix Corporation when REPLACED releases on April 14, 2026, on PC and Xbox. 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663850/REPLACED/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/replaced/9nv3l234vgxd

REPLACED is a 2.5D cinematic action platformer wrapped in an intense cyberpunk thriller narrative. Run, climb, and fight through crumbling districts, industrial wastelands, and neon-lit alleys with fluid movement and fast, responsive combat. Chain precise melee strikes with satisfying ranged attacks to take down enemies in high-intensity encounters while keeping the flow of exploration.

Follow REPLACED on social media to stay up to date!

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/replaced_game/
